articles.title: OG.com cleared by SEC to offer single-stock futures, says Crypto.com CEO
articles.summary: Crypto.com’s CEO said its sister exchange was cleared to offer US access to single-stock perpetual futures, as the latest platform to bridge TradFi and digital assets.

articles.title: U.S. diesel prices hit record high as bitcoin and gold struggle
articles.summary: Record diesel prices could feed through to consumer price inflation, confirming more Fed rate hikes. The central bank appears determined to raise rates into a oil supply shock.

articles.title: Revolut says no direct contact from hackers after $3M public ransom demand
articles.summary: Revolut says it received no direct contact despite separate ransom demands for $3 million in Monero and 10,000 Bitcoin from competing breach claimants.

articles.title: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior
articles.summary: The six cases are separate from July’s incident, when OpenAI models escaped containment and hacked Hugging Face during a security evaluation.

articles.title: Crypto rallies through the Fed's first rate increase since 2023
articles.summary: Bitcoin rose 0.88% over 24 hours to $76,621 as the central bank's projections implied only one further hike. Zcash jumped 23% to a record after Paradigm disclosed a stake.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin continues near $76,000 as stocks surge following Fed rate hike
articles.summary: The SEC debuted its long-awaited "innovation exemption," providing a roadmap for blockchain-based venues to offer tokenized securities.

articles.title: Bitcoin faces 2022 parallels as Federal Reserve resumes rate increases
articles.summary: Bitcoin’s drawdown mirrors its position before the Fed’s first hike in March 2022, raising questions over whether a relief rally could precede further losses.

articles.title: Fed raises rates by 25 basis points in first hike since July 2023
articles.summary: The widely expected move places the U.S. Federal Reserve's benchmark fed funds rate range at 3.75%-4.0%.

articles.title: SEC rolls out long-awaited 'innovation exemption' for tokenized securities venues
articles.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued a blanket 5-year exemption for listing and trading tokenized securities without registering as an exchange.

articles.title: Polymarket users referred to prosecutors in South Korea: Report
articles.summary: South Korean police reportedly referred 18 Polymarket users to prosecutors in a gambling probe involving 26 people and $12.7 million in bets.

articles.title: Clarity Act failure may hamper U.S. crypto as industry seeks legal clarity elsewhere
articles.summary: The U.S. is likely to lose out to foreign markets in the short term, but SEC and CFTC rules will help underpin the industry.

articles.title: SEC Issues “Innovation Exemption” to Facilitate the Trading of Tokenized NMS Stock and Request for Comment
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission today issued an order granting temporary, conditional exemptive relief to Tokenized Securities Venues each a “TSV” from the definition of “exchange” in the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (Exchange Act) to trade…

articles.title: Goldman pivots, now forecasts Fed rate hike in October
articles.summary: The Fed is likely to raise rates by 25 basis points in October, Goldman said, drawing attention to Fed's own hawkish near term rate projections.

articles.title: Bitcoin absorbs Fed rate hike as officials see more tightening
articles.summary: Bitcoin showed little immediate reaction to the Fed’s first rate increase since 2023, but 16 of 18 officials expect at least one more hike before the end of the year.

articles.title: US House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38–5 vote
articles.summary: A bipartisan House committee vote advanced legislation that would reshape federal tax rules for stablecoins, staking, crypto lending and digital asset transactions.

articles.title: Anchorage expands institutional custody to Etherlink, tokenized uranium
articles.summary: Anchorage Digital Bank added custody support for Etherlink and several Etherlink-based assets, including xU3O8, a token representing physical uranium.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading
articles.summary: The SEC’s Innovation Exemption allows limited tokenized US stock trading on onchain venues with trading caps and transparency requirements.

articles.title: Ratings giant S&P Global acquires OpenZeppelin in tokenized finance risk push
articles.summary: Building on its recent market-data investment in Kaiko, S&P Global’s latest purchase targets the technological risks facing banks and asset managers onchain.

articles.title: SEC Proposes Rescission of Shareholder Proposal Rule and Reforms to Proxy Solicitation Process
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission today proposed to rescind Rule 14a-8 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, which exceeds the scope of the Commission's statutory authority and intrudes into matters of state law.The Commission outlined…

articles.title: S&P Global to acquire blockchain security platform OpenZeppelin
articles.summary: S&P Global agreed to buy OpenZeppelin, which says its smart contracts have facilitated more than $37 trillion in value transfers.

articles.title: State hackers drive 420% surge in onchain malware, Chainalysis finds
articles.summary: North Korea-linked hackers used Tron, Aptos and BNB Chain to maintain malware infrastructure, while suspected Iran-linked actors embedded directions in Bitcoin transactions.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?
articles.summary: Bitcoin treasury companies promise to amplify returns over investing in Bitcoin alone, but does the potential upside outweigh the risks to the downside?

articles.title: Group behind Revolut data breach demands $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
articles.summary: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings. Revolut said it has not not received any direct contact from the individuals.

articles.title: Zcash miner Fortitude names former Hut 8 chief Jaime Leverton CEO ahead of Nasdaq deal
articles.summary: Leverton will lead the DCG-owned mining company as it pursues a public listing through its proposed merger with HeartSciences.

articles.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
articles.summary: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.

articles.title: Ethereum’s upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade clears rehearsal for a big jump in capacity
articles.summary: The test network raised its limit on work per block toward 200 million gas as developers prepare for a proposed October 6 public test.

articles.title: BitMEX faces Celsius lawsuit ahead of exchange closure
articles.summary: The Celsius estate alleges BitMEX wrongfully liquidated and seized 6,360 BTC, worth nearly $490 million, during the March 2020 market crash.

articles.title: UK FCA sets crypto authorization guidance ahead of September application window
articles.summary: The FCA’s new guidance outlines which crypto activities may require authorization as firms prepare for the UK’s incoming digital asset regulatory regime.

articles.title: Celsius sues BitMEX for $495 million over 2020 crash liquidations
articles.summary: The estate is chasing 6,360 BTC lost in the Covid crash — a leveraged long position that sits awkwardly with the lender's delta-neutral marketing.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasuries buy just 5.9K BTC in three months as paper losses linger
articles.summary: Bitcoin corporate treasuries remained at an unrealized loss on their holdings as the price fell below $80,000 and fresh capital inflows dwindled.

articles.title: US lawmakers advance bill to lock Trump’s Bitcoin reserve into law
articles.summary: The legislation seeks to codify Trump’s Bitcoin reserve policy, locking up Bitcoin acquired through civil and criminal forfeiture for 20 years.

articles.title: USDT payments feature in Polish energy giant’s failed $230M oil deal: FT
articles.summary: Tether’s USDT stablecoin was part of a failed oil trade that reportedly cost a Polish energy giant $230 million in late 2023.

articles.title: How Circle’s institutional Arc blockchain got taken over by memecoins on day one
articles.summary: Circle blockchain Arc's first day was dominated by memecoins, and the traders behind them had already moved on by Thursday morning.

articles.title: Crypto adoption blooming in Germany, while UK is falling ‘behind,’ says CoinShares researcher
articles.summary: German crypto adoption is progressing through family offices and wealth managers, while the UK’s retail-facing cryptocurrency market remains “nascent,” according to the researcher.

articles.title: Optimism creeps back into crypto, with the 2022 test still to come
articles.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 17, 2026

articles.title: Zcash gains 20% as Paradigm founder reveals firm made ZEC investment
articles.summary: Zcash rose about 20% in 24 hours as Paradigm co-founder Matt Huang disclosed that the firm invested in ZEC amid a broader crypto market rally.

articles.title: Ripple adds XRP payments to Stripe and Tempo’s AI standard in new developer kit
articles.summary: The update expands support for automated payments in XRP and RLUSD, with tools that let agents pay repeatedly for services and manage wallets across blockchains.

articles.title: CLARITY Act could get another shot during lame-duck session, policy advocate says
articles.summary: Digital Sovereignty Alliance managing director Adrian Wall said senators from both parties are considering another attempt to advance the crypto market structure bill before the current Congress ends.

articles.title: U.S. House's tax committee advances crypto tax bill in wake of Clarity Act loss
articles.summary: The Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act would ease complicated tax burdens for everyday use of cryptocurrencies, though Trump's industry ties spurred some pushback.

articles.title: Hamas military wing told donors to avoid sending crypto directly from Binance, DOJ filing shows
articles.summary: Hamas’ military wing advised donors not to use Binance to handle funds but rather to use Trust Wallet, Bybit, OKX, Kast and Redotpay to send funds to an external TRON wallet, according to recent U.S. Department of Justice documents.
